example.transcript:
AGENT: Salt Bank, good afternoon, how can I help?
CUSTOMER: Hi, I lost my card yesterday and I want to block it.
AGENT: I'm sorry to hear that. I can block it right now. Can you confirm your name and date of birth?
CUSTOMER: Yes, it's Ana M., born on the 14th of March.
AGENT: Thank you. Your card ending [REDACTED] is now blocked. Shall I order a replacement?
CUSTOMER: Yes please, to my home address.
AGENT: Done. It arrives in 3 to 5 working days. Anything else?
CUSTOMER: No, thank you very much.
example.summary: Customer reported a lost card and requested it be blocked. Agent successfully blocked the card ending in [REDACTED] and ordered a replacement to be delivered to the customer's home address within 3-5 working days.
